archetype: Electric & Neon (Future, Speed, Disruption) adapted to 'Watch-Dawg-AI' (Terminal / AI Auditor)

headings.rules: Use font-light to font-black for tension. Tracking-tighter for h1/h2.

mono.rules: MANDATORY for JSON editor, Transaction Audit logs, Ledger Reconciliation figures, Health score metrics.

primary.description: Electric Cyan - Represents AI processing and 'watching'.

accent.description: High contrast status colors for anomaly review list and health score.

visual_enhancers.surfaces: Grid Borders (The Technical Look). Expose the skeleton. Dashboards must have 1px solid borders (border-border/40). No soft muddy shadows. Use sharp 1px borders to separate dashboard widgets.
visual_enhancers.effects: Retro-Futurism terminal glow for the JSON editor and Anomaly list. Subtle drop-shadow-[0_0_8px_rgba(0,229,255,0.3)] on key metrics. Glassmorphism for sticky headers only.
visual_enhancers.textures: Subtle noise overlay on the base background to avoid digital flatness.

grids_and_layouts.spacing: Generous Spacing Philosophy. Use Tailwind scale generously, but for dashboards (Mode B: High Density), use gap-4 to gap-6. Dashboards must look dense and compact for scanability.
grids_and_layouts.dashboard_grid: Base grid: grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4. The main ledger reconciliation/audit view gets col-span-3, anomaly review gets col-span-1. JSON editor gets full width row at bottom or split screen.
grids_and_layouts.alignment: Left-align dense data, tables, and JSON. Only center-align empty states or DAW health score ring.

motion.rules: Micro-interactions for feedback. Hovering rows in transaction audit highlights them slightly (bg-white/5). Do NOT use universal 'transition: all'. Explicitly transition transform and opacity.
motion.components: Tracer beam border effect for the 'DAW Health Score' card to emphasize active monitoring.

components.strategy: Shadcn UI heavily customized. Cardless, flat rectangular designs. Remove default border-radius (rounded-none or max rounded-sm). Use Shadcn tables for transaction audit, Shadcn charts for ledger reconciliation visual.

specifics.json_editor: Use Monaco Editor or a styled syntax-highlighted div with JetBrains Mono. Sharp edges, dark background (#000000).
specifics.health_score: Large radial progress or typography-driven metric. Number must be huge (text-6xl) and use tracking-tighter.
specifics.anomaly_list: Dense list. Items with anomalies must have a left border accent (border-l-2 border-danger) to quickly draw the eye.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure text over dark backgrounds meets APCA standards. Dimmed text must not fall below #A1A1AA against #09090B.
accessibility.testing: All interactive elements MUST include data-testid attribute. E.g., data-testid='audit-transaction-row', data-testid='health-score-metric'.

media.icons: Use Phosphor Icons (yarn add @phosphor-icons/react). They fit the high-end dashboard look perfectly.

background_abstract.description: Blue background with lines and dots - use as a very low opacity (10%) background behind the hero or login section for the dashboard.

data_cubes.description: Abstract data cubes on black - use for empty states or anomaly detection placeholder graphics.

3d_libraries.usage: If visualizing the 'Ledger Reconciliation' or 'Allocation Rule Verification' as a network graph, use React Force Graph 3D for a high-tech 'AI Brain' node connection view.

instructions_to_main_agent: Prioritize a strict, high-density dashboard grid.
Use Phosphor icons. Install using `yarn add @phosphor-icons/react`.
Do not use generic Inter font for headings. Setup Unbounded for headings, IBM Plex Sans for Body, and JetBrains Mono for data points/tables.
Avoid Shadcn's default rounded card look. Override with rounded-sm or rounded-none, flat colors (#09090B or #121217) and 1px border-white/10.
Ensure the JSON editor and transaction audit feel like a true developer/financial tool—dense, scanable, highly technical.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. In frontend design, this creates what users call the 'AI slop' aesthetic. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur).
You MUST NOT apply universal transition. Eg: transition: all. Always add transitions for specific interactive elements.
You MUST NOT center align the app container, ie do not add .App { text-align: center; } in the css file.
Always use modern button styles like pill-shaped, or sharp button with interaction animations & color relevant to the app style.
NEVER: use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯 etc for icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
Prioritize using pre-existing components from src/components/ui when applicable.
